text: The 1953 diff reads the message key before GetMessageHeader and takes OpenFileSocket for key zero. Its comment explains that header lookup otherwise walks folders looking for a database matching the external file path. That is a reported mechanism tied to this protocol path and matches the accepted early branch. Proposed performance regression check: open an external EML with many folders and verify that the header-lookup path is bypassed; no timing or folder-walk trace was collected here. Folder-backed nonzero lookup and its failures remain separate. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: The EML performance fix moves the discriminator before expensive header lookup
